correctness.rationale: The measured operators are canonical incidence projectors, not association-scheme vertex idempotents. For a unit edge dipole b, the mean-zero potential on either noncomplete strongly regular graph is αb+βAb, where A is vertex adjacency; using A²b=(λ−μ)Ab+(k−μ)b gives α=(k−λ+μ)β and β=[k(k−λ+μ)−k+μ]⁻¹. At the source edge and its exclusive neighbors this gives the stated U,V and U,W; shared and doubly nonadjacent types cancel. T_3 is checked directly as a triangle. In the triangular graph the two opposite nonzero n−3 families cross only at the same outside label; in the Kneser graph the two opposite families cross at distinct outside labels, giving 4(n−4)(n−5) edges, with the other W-drops to mixed pairs and fully outside pairs as listed. The absolute sums and complement correction q+1−2Q_ee give the four rational expressions; swapping coordinates by graph automorphisms or orientations leaves all absolute column sums invariant, and symmetry handles ℓ∞. Consecutive differences have the reported signs. In particular the cubic n(n−11)(n−4)−40 is negative at 5≤n≤11 and is already positive at 12 and increasing thereafter. This gives the asserted peaks, values and limiting constants.
residual_risks: Representative-column checks use edge transitivity and are finite; the all-size result follows from the formulas and difference signs.
